original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP_NVME_N1 through NN sensors are correctly mapped to their physical N-group bays and installed drives and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved NVMe thermal specification.
original_method: Enumerate the complete N-group bay/drive population and immutable BMC raw/UI sensor identities, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized drive identity, health, power state and optionally approved same-drive telemetry, and compare results under the owner correlation and timing rules.
manual_activity: The owner provides N-group bay/drive/sensor mapping, thermal limits and any device-telemetry correlation rule; an operator verifies raw/UI/drive identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and NVMe N1..NN bay/drive inventory
Physical N-group bay to drive serial/namespace and SDR/Redfish/UI sensor mapping
Temperature unit/scale/warning/critical threshold and expected range specification
Approved relationship and timing between BMC sensor and read-only same-drive NVMe telemetry
UI refresh/rounding/lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never write storage, start an unapproved workload or change drive power/thermal/cooling policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to physical N-group bay and immutable drive identity at synchronized times
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on NVMe health/thermal alarm, I/O impact, stale/impossible value, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not assume BMC and device temperatures must match or retry after creating load
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify all N-group NVMe bay, drive and sensor mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only drive context
Assist with synchronized WebUI and approved same-drive telemetry capture/normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/device/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no storage workload/write or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative N-group topology, thermal limits and BMC/device correlation rules
Review bay/drive identity, sensor-location, timing and raw/UI/device discrepancies

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate complete BMC sensor and NVMe inventory, join each owner-mapped N-group bay to immutable drive and sensor identities, capture full read-only metadata/context, then correlate WebUI and any approved device telemetry under the timing specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_NVME_N1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED NVME N-GROUP TEMPERATURE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-bay matrix of N-group slot, drive identity/power/health, BMC sensor identity/value/threshold and UI display, plus approved same-drive telemetry with timestamps and location/lag interpretation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable N-group bay-to-drive mapping and source-aware thermal correlation while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and workload generation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One sensor value or screenshot cannot cover N1..NN or prove the installed drive. Every expected N-group bay/sensor and occupied/empty state must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC may sense a bay/backplane while device telemetry is internal; different location and polling paths can legitimately disagree within an owner-defined relationship.

project_override_considerations: If empty N-group bays omit sensors or retain enclosure temperatures, the owner must define expected empty-state behavior; B-group or NIC temperature rows cannot fill missing N-group coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/NVMe N-group topology/thermal spec revision
Per-N-group bay to drive serial/namespace and raw/UI sensor identity matrix
Complete BMC temperature/unit/status/threshold/entity/timestamp plus drive health/power-state context
Synchronized WebUI and approved same-drive telemetry with source/location/lag comparison
Per-bay discrepancies, no-workload/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target N-group NVMe temperatures and thresholds. Exact bay mapping and BMC-versus-device correlation are project inputs rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: N-group topology, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/drive-context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Preserves the N-group namespace and requires immutable bay-to-drive mapping plus source-aware thermal correlation for every expected channel.
independent_technical_reasoning: The N prefix defines a distinct physical inventory boundary, not a generic alias for all NVMe devices. Drive replacement and hot-swap can invalidate label-only evidence, so bay, serial/namespace and sensor identifiers must be captured together. A BMC bay or backplane sensor may not match internal device telemetry due to placement and polling. Empty-bay behavior also requires explicit owner rules instead of borrowing B-group evidence.
